appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Choose how the admin workspace is laid out for you. It's a personal preference: it's saved for your account and, for now, applies on this browser.

layout.title: Admin layout
layout.body: Pick a starting layout, fine-tune it, and try it live before you keep it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.body: Your navigation, in miniature. Try it live to use the whole app with this layout.
preview.label: Preview of the {name} layout
preview.liveHint: Changes you make now apply to the app straight away. Keep or go back from the bar at the bottom.
preview.sameAsSaved: This is the layout you're using.

options.title: Options
options.body: Only the settings that apply to {name} are shown.

sidebarState.label: Sidebar at start
sidebarState.hint: How the sidebar opens when you sign in. You can still collapse it any time.

sidebarSticky.label: Sticky sidebar
sidebarSticky.hint: The sidebar stays in place while the page scrolls.

labels.label: Navigation labels
labels.hint: Show names next to the icons, or only when you point at them.

headerSticky.label: Sticky header
headerSticky.hint: The header stays at the top while the page scrolls.

contentWidth.label: Content width
contentWidth.hint: Use the full screen, or keep pages to a comfortable reading width.

density.label: Density
density.hint: Compact fits more on screen with slightly smaller text.

borders.label: Borders
borders.hint: How visible lines and card edges are.

shadows.label: Shadows
shadows.hint: How much cards and menus lift off the page.

actions.unsavedHint: Save to use it every time you sign in.

default.name: Default
default.description: Full sidebar with page names, header across the top.

compact.name: Compact sidebar
compact.description: Icon rail that opens on hover; pin it to keep it open.

mini.name: Mini sidebar
mini.description: Small fixed rail with icons and short names. More room for content.

topnav.name: Top navigation
topnav.description: No sidebar. Modules open as menus in the header.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.description: Modules in the header, the current module's pages in a slim side menu.

previewBar.title: Previewing {name}.
previewBar.body: Look around, then keep it or go back.
